question:
A sentence has been given with a blank to be filled with an appropriate word. Choose the correct alternative.

This year, orange prices are forecast to grow, despite an expected increase in global ______.
solution:
The correct answer is 'Production'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• We need to fill the blank with the **most appropriate word .**
 
• Here, the** sentence** implies that orange prices are forecast to grow this year despite an expected increase in their **yield.**
 
• **We** need to fill the blank with the synonym of **yield.**
 
• The marked option** 'production' **means the amount of something that is made or grown.(उत्‍पादित या उत्‍पन्‍न वस्‍तु की मात्रा).
 
 
• ***Example: **The cotton factories excel chiefly in the** production** of red and printed cottons.*
 
 
 
• *​Thus,*the correct answer is** option 1.**
